caption: The drawing features a single ceramic pitcher with a handle, depicted against a plain, light background. The pitcher has a wide, slightly flared spout and a rounded, narrowing neck that leads to a broader body before tapering again at the base. Its surface is decorated with symmetrical, swirling floral and foliate patterns in a darker brown shade, contrasting against the lighter brown and earthy tones of the pitcher itself. The handle, attached on one side near the spout and midsection, is similarly colored to the rest of the pitcher and features a simple, smooth curve. The overall composition centers the pitcher on the page, and the artist's signature "BETTY JACOB" appears in small, reddish-brown text near the bottom right of the image.
title: Redware Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
